== Ingredients ==
* 1 pound [[Cookbook:Beef#Loin|filet mignon]], pounded flat
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 small [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Julienne|julienned]]
* Hoagie rolls, almost halved
* [[Cookbook:Processed Cheese|American cheese]] slices, torn

== Procedure ==
#Drizzle filet with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper. [[Cookbook:Searing|Sear]] in a [[Cookbook:Cast Iron|cast-iron]] [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] over medium heat for 6 minutes per side. Remove and let rest 7 minutes before slicing into bite-size pieces. Keep warm. 
#[[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] onion with a little olive oil and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] in same pan until lightly browned around edges.
#To serve, place a big scoop of steak into a hoagie roll. Top with onion and torn cheese. Serve.

steps.text: Drizzle filet with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper. Sear in a cast-iron skillet over medium heat for 6 minutes per side. Remove and let rest 7 minutes before slicing into bite-size pieces. Keep warm.
Toss onion with a little olive oil and sauté in same pan until lightly browned around edges.
To serve, place a big scoop of steak into a hoagie roll. Top with onion and torn cheese. Serve.
